lines.l: I crush them, push them away, to mute the things I couldn't say, while up and all around me, arms are reaching, they're preaching, down from old weird trees, their eyes are turning on me.
I had this fear in my throat
or closed your eyes you're so polite oh no now it's growing on me
one minute of silence now for all the words unspoken
one minute of silence now for everything yet unsaid
And on our street, somewhere last covered in leaves
So peacefully, and all ears for me
sweet times we're living in but so carefully all ears for me
